mapper.select: SELECT fair_id , reservation_fee , reservation_start_date , reservation_end_date , published_at , canceled_at , pet_allowed FROM fairs WHERE fair_id = #{fairId}

SELECT fd.operation_date AS visit_date , fd.entry_start_time , fd.entry_end_time , fd.capacity , fd.reserved_count AS occupied_count FROM fair_dates fd WHERE fd.fair_id = #{fairId} AND fd.operation_date > #{today} ORDER BY fd.operation_date ASC

SELECT r.reservation_id , f.name AS fair_name , f.poster_image_url AS fair_poster_image_url , r.visit_date , fd.entry_start_time , fd.entry_end_time , r.status AS reservation_status , r.reservation_amount AS amount , r.reserved_at , r.payment_expires_at , er.first_checked_in_at AS checked_in_at FROM reservations r JOIN fairs f ON f.fair_id = r.fair_id JOIN fair_dates fd ON fd.fair_id = r.fair_id AND fd.operation_date = r.visit_date LEFT JOIN entry_records er ON er.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status != 'EXPIRED' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.reservation_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != 'EXPIRED'

SELECT r.reservation_id , r.reservation_no , r.fair_id , f.name AS fair_name , f.poster_image_url AS fair_poster_image_url , r.visit_date , fd.entry_start_time , fd.entry_end_time , r.status AS reservation_status , r.reservation_type , r.reservation_amount AS amount , r.reserved_at , r.payment_expires_at , er.first_checked_in_at AS checked_in_at , p.payment_id , p.status AS payment_status , p.method AS payment_method , p.easy_pay_provider AS easy_pay_provider FROM reservations r JOIN fairs f ON f.fair_id = r.fair_id JOIN fair_dates fd ON fd.fair_id = r.fair_id AND fd.operation_date = r.visit_date LEFT JOIN entry_records er ON er.reservation_id = r.reservation_id
LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id AND p.payment_type = 'RESERVATION_DEPOSIT' WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND r.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT f.fair_id , f.name AS fair_name , f.status AS fair_status , f.reservation_start_date , f.reservation_end_date , f.reservation_fee , f.published_at , f.canceled_at , f.pet_allowed , fd.fair_date_id , fd.operation_date , fd.capacity FROM fairs f JOIN fair_dates fd ON fd.fair_id = f.fair_id WHERE f.fair_id = #{fairId} AND fd.operation_date = #{visitDate}
SELECT user_id , nickname , phone , email , role , status FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_histories ( reservation_id , action_type , before_data , after_data , changed_by , is_admin_action , change_reason , created_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationId} , 'CREATED' , NULL , JSON_OBJECT('status', #{status}) , #{changedBy} , FALSE , NULL , NOW() )
